blocks.heading: The short version
blocks.intro: Most people who find you will be on a phone. Your site is slowest there.

items.label: Mobile score
items.note: On a phone, the main content takes almost 10 seconds to show. Many visitors leave before that.

items.label: Desktop score
items.note: Faster than mobile, but still well short of the 90 that Google rates as good.

blocks.heading: The numbers behind the score
blocks.intro: Five measures decide most of your score. Red means Google rates it poor. Amber means it needs improvement. Green means good.
blocks.note: Source: Google PageSpeed Insights. Good targets are LCP under 2.5 s, TBT under 200 ms and CLS under 0.1.

blocks.heading: What we found
blocks.intro: Three issues account for most of the delay. Each one is fixable.

items.title: Scripts and styles hold up the page
items.body: The browser has to load these files before it can show anything. On a phone that wait costs an estimated 3,250 ms.
items.evidence: Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile. Render blocking requests: estimated savings of 3,250 ms.

items.title: The main content takes 9.9 seconds to appear on a phone
items.body: Google rates anything over 4 seconds as poor. A homeowner with a broken AC will not wait that long.
items.evidence: Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile. Largest Contentful Paint: 9.9 s. On desktop it is 5.0 s.

items.title: Images are heavier than they need to be
items.body: The photos on the page are larger than what a phone needs. Resizing and compressing them cuts load time without changing how the page looks.
items.evidence: Google PageSpeed Insights, mobile. Improved image delivery: estimated savings of 531 KiB.

blocks.heading: How you compare
blocks.intro: Every site in this group is slow. Right now yours is the slowest of the four, by a small margin on phones. That leaves room to move first. Fixing the causes above would put you ahead of all three.
blocks.note: Scores from Google PageSpeed Insights. Mondragon was tested for this report. The other three were measured earlier and may have changed. Below 50 is poor, 50 to 89 needs improvement, 90 and up is good.

blocks.heading: Do AI tools recommend you?
blocks.intro: More people now ask an AI tool who to call. We asked each one the same kind of question. Mondragon Mechanical did not come up in any of them.

items.title: Stop scripts and styles from blocking the page
items.body: Load only what the first screen needs, and load the rest after. This is the biggest single gain on phones.

items.title: Resize and compress the images
items.body: Serve each photo at the size the screen needs, in a modern format. Load the top image first.

items.title: Stop the layout from jumping
items.body: Reserve space for images and the chat widget so the page does not shift as it loads.

items.title: Make your services and service area easy to read
items.body: Plain pages for repair, installation and maintenance, each naming the Dallas neighborhoods you cover. This helps search engines and AI tools understand who you are.

blocks.heading: Be the first to fix it
blocks.body: Every site in this group is slow, so the first one to fix it stands out. We can walk you through this report in twenty minutes. No pitch deck. Just the numbers and what we would fix.
